description: This PHP class extends PHPStan's reflection system to provide custom property reflection for the Registry class in the Opencart system. It defines default properties and dynamically resolves properties based on naming conventions, facilitating static analysis and type inference within the Opencart project.

classes.name: Tools\PHPStan\RegistryPropertyReflectionExtension
classes.description: A PHPStan extension class that provides custom reflection for properties of the Registry class, including default and dynamically discovered properties based on naming conventions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the extension with a ReflectionProvider instance.

methods.name: hasProperty
methods.description: Determines if a given property exists on the Registry class, either as a default property or based on naming pattern.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Returns the reflection of a property, either as a predefined type or by dynamically resolving class types based on naming conventions.

methods.name: convertSnakeToStudly
methods.description: Converts snake_case strings to StudlyCaps format for class name construction.
